set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Execution: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Work key: O03.7
Accountable role (person unassigned): Recovery/backend engineer
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Implement the reusable restore engine and packaged operator workflow for the current authority capability profile. O03.4 later qualifies all identity/session and future authority integrations using this same engine.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O03 (bd-01M4W40KBWB13MJQHFAGJEGYZR)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Consume the exact verified H03.1 backup bundle into a fresh catalog and blob target, with access/readiness closed before any server or worker starts. Verify schema/artifact/capability compatibility, complete manifests and every required scientific blob; a partial, corrupt or incompatible bundle cannot reopen.
2. Obtain an authenticated fresh barrier/head from the independently trusted live witness, fence the old writer and verify checkpoint authenticity, contiguous history, installation/epoch, generations and all supported event schemas. Reject stale, truncated, reordered, tampered or foreign evidence and unresolved preparations; no old backup row or timestamp proves currentness.
3. Reconstruct current organization, principal, membership, stewardship, custody/placement, grant/expiry and credential policy without rewriting retained scientific IDs, manifests, interpretations or actor attribution. Preserve restrictive tombstones even when their targets are absent from the older scientific backup; evaluate expiry at the recovery clock.
4. Invalidate every restored API credential and worker/delivery lease, require governed fresh credential admission, and reject any unsupported enabled capability or unknown event kind. Browser-session and guest-lifecycle recovery remain mandatory O03.2/O03.4 acceptance before those capabilities are supported by this recovery profile.
5. Persist an attributable recovery receipt bound to backup identity, exact witness head/epoch, operator and verification outcomes. Reopen atomically only after successful barrier release. Crash/retry before or after release must be idempotent and leave the gate closed until the same recovery session finishes; no manual flag toggle is an accepted recovery path.
6. Ship documented preview/verify/reconcile/status behavior in the packaged operator CLI with least-privilege checks, bounded diagnostics, secret canaries and a local runbook for missing witness, unsupported profile and interrupted recovery. Legacy capture/reconcile continue to refuse organization catalogs; ordinary startup checks enforce the new witness admission contract.

Verification: Packaged CLI against a fresh disposable database/storage target; closed-gate API and worker probes throughout restore, injected failure at each reopening boundary, exact release/export comparison and repeatable operator runbook.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.7/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresOrganizationCatalog.scala
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/RecoveryCli.scala
- scripts/backup-postgres.sh
- scripts/restore-postgres.sh

Blocked by:
- O03.6: bd-01M4XPCN6RSRCS8CB96BR5Y8GY
- H03.1: bd-01M4X8MA9J2FXA82A9RVB85YD9

User-approved recovery priority, 14 October 2026. Current-capability recovery precedes browser expansion; full identity/session/lifecycle and institutional qualification remain mandatory.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; no institutional or physical-failure qualification from same-host fixtures. Planning closes no implementation work.
set.title: O03.7: Restore organization catalogs through a closed operator command
